decisions.reason: The indexing figures satisfy the reporting requirement, but the new instruction to submit unindexed links through an indexer does not change the report's required content or scope.
The replacement-policy question is independently represented from the same message and remains unresolved; the re-indexing instruction does not establish or change the replacement policy.
The backlink re-indexing instruction does not alter the previously delivered SEO plan's required service areas or format.
Submitting 164 currently unindexed links through an indexer is remediation for campaign outputs and does not change the campaign's required backlink count or dofollow-to-nofollow ratio.
The source concerns indexing externally created backlinks, not sitemap submission, processing, or configuration.
The backlink re-indexing instruction does not affect completion of the website's heading suggestions.
The backlink re-indexing instruction does not affect implementation of image ALT suggestions.
The source does not change the approved webpage-content revisions or their implementation obligation.
The source does not mention or alter the Campus Launch sale page or its editing interface.
The source message does not change the requested before-and-after metadata report; that deliverable is addressed separately in the following message.
The backlink re-indexing instruction has no effect on the keyword count, replacement keywords, or required search-volume data.
The source concerns external backlinks that are not indexed, not internal links within blog articles.
